body.name: Full observational Markov-equivalence input
body.construction: \(\mathcal O_0(\eta)=\mathcal I(M_0(\eta))\) is the conditional-independence signature associated with the observational selected law \(P_{\eta}^{(0)}=\mathcal L_{\eta}(X\mid S^*=\mathbf 1)\), where \(\mathcal I(M)\) is the complete set of conditional-independence relations entailed by \(m\)-separation in \(M\). At \(K=0\), this definition contains no regime index and no \(\zeta_k\).
